before.name: Swift Panther Warrior
before.description:
During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 other monster from your hand or field, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Special Summon 1 monster that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your hand or Deck, except "Swift Panther Warrior".
● Send 1 Spell/Trap that mentions "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to the GY.
You can only use this effect of "Swift Panther Warrior" once per turn. Cannot declare an attack unless a monster(s) was Tributed this turn.

before.name: Alligator's Sword Dragon Knight
before.description: Can attack directly. You can only use each of the following effects of "Alligator's Sword Dragon Knight" once per turn. If this card is in your hand: You can reveal 1 other card in your hand that mentions "Dark Time Wizard"; Special Summon this card. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add up to 2 Spells/Traps with different names from each other that mention "Dark Time Wizard" from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card.

before.name: Destiny HERO - Death Dogma
before.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by banishing 3 Warrior and/or DARK monsters from your GY. You can only Special Summon "Destiny HERO - Death Dogma" once per turn this way. If Summoned this way: You can activate this effect; inflict 2000 damage to your opponent during the next Standby Phase. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can Fusion Summon 1 DARK or Warrior Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling its materials from your hand, field, and/or GY into the Deck.
